facts.fact: Djibouti launched its National Summary Data Page (PNRD) under the IMF e-GDDS on 12 June 2025 at the Central Bank, built by Central Bank, INSTAD and Budget Ministry staff with the IMF and AfDB, publicly accessible worldwide and hosted on the Djibouti Open Data Platform.

systems.owner: Banque Centrale de Djibouti with INSTAD and Ministry of Budget

note: Breadth not recorded: document names bodies that built the page, not several bodies publishing data on it.
